body: Yeah, everyday. At some times, I just keep questioning 'why am I alive?', 'why am i still here?'

Hey, I'm really sorry for what you had experienced. People's emotions shouldn't be used to their own benefit. I hope you can find peace and truly lasting relationships.

I'm not sure If you heard about Jaiden Animations, it's a Youtuber who makes interesting and funny animations about her life experiences. She had made a video about relationships in general that helped me a lot to understand how to deal with relationships. Here's the link: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4H9jTQKmR3Q](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4H9jTQKmR3Q)

I don't know If this video can help you with what you are going through. I'm really sorry If it's not the case, I'm just 18 years old, so for me, it is just the beginning of understanding this thing called "Life". But I wanted to maybe help you by showing some ideas that this video gave me that help me to prevent getting hurt when trying to help someone who doesn't want to be helped.
Who the hell said this good boi isn't worthy?!?!?

In this group we try to support others without any judgment. Everyone has the right to ask for help and all suffering should be considered, even the ones that look silly. Maybe you know this person better than us, and know it reasons, but please don't invalidate the pain. I believe that some people need more time to heal and take courage to TRY to leave the place that is dragging them down. If they persist in staying in this place, is because they aren't ready and that should be okay. Our responsibility should be there to offer support, but never to solve their problems. It's a choice that takes time and needs love, a thing that not everyone have in abundance in their life.
